title: Rhodamine based turn-on dual mode chemosensor for the selective recognition of nickel ions: practical and theoretical applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1641-1657
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08258C, Paper
Open Access

This work presents the development of a rhodamine-based colorimetric and turn-on fluorescent chemosensor (P1) designed for selective recognition of Ni2+ ions.
